description: Hi we are students from Uruguay!
summary: The Interplanetary Banana is a space-themed action video game created in Microsoft MakeCode Arcade by a team of students from Uruguay. The player controls a brave banana on a journey that starts on Mars and travels deeper into space, fighting enemies along the way. The game has four levels that get harder as you advance. In the first level, the banana must defeat waves of aliens and reach 300 points. Then come three boss battles: Mr. M, who throws spears; Ghost Boss, a ghost with faster and harder special attacks; and finally Eclipse, a powerful boss who launches black holes. Each boss has more health and stronger attacks than the last. Our goal was to create a fun, challenging game that sparks curiosity about Mars and space, while we learned programming, game design and teamwork.
details:
What it does and how it works. The player has three lives and loses one each time an enemy or attack hits the banana. The game is divided into four levels:

  1. Level 1 – Alien invasion: aliens keep appearing, and the player must defeat them without being touched, reaching 300 points to advance.
  2. Level 2 – Mr. M (50 health points): throws spears at the player, and every 20 seconds launches a special attack of several spears that spread out.
  3. Level 3 – Ghost Boss (100 health points): throws the same spears, but his special attack comes every 10 seconds and is much harder to dodge.
  4. Level 4 – Eclipse (200 health points): launches black holes, plus a special attack made of smaller black holes.

Benefits and intended impact. The game shows young players that space is full of challenges, from the surface of Mars to black holes, and encourages them to learn more. It also shows that kids can create their own games using programming.

Tools used. Microsoft MakeCode Arcade (block-based programming) for the game and its pixel-art characters, and Canva for the presentation.

Creativity. We designed all our characters in pixel art: the banana hero, the alien and three unique bosses, each with its own attack style. The difficulty grows step by step, with every boss doubling the health of the previous one and attacking more often.

Factors we considered. Balancing the difficulty so the game is challenging but fair, giving each boss a different personality and attack, and using timers for special attacks so players can learn the patterns and improve.
